PartnerAllocation.description:
A contractual allocation under an agreement: the event or product, the quantity or percent of capacity, the commitment and the release rule. Booked, sold and remaining are counted from orders against it, not stored (decided 29 September, data model DM4)

**Written by** setPartnerAllocations, which replaces the agreement's allocations as a set; a new or increased guaranteed allocation goes through approvals.request. The corporate allocations once held on `PartnerAgreement.corporateAllocations` are rows here, with `perMemberLimit` (decided 29 September, writers pass; DM4).

releaseHoursBeforeEvent.description: Release deadline before the event (e.g. 48 hours).

releaseDate.description: Release at a fixed time instead.

perMemberLimit.description: For a corporate allocation: places one member (employee) may take from it; empty for no per-member limit. Carried over from the retired `PartnerAgreement.corporateAllocations` (decided 29 September, writers pass; DM4)

PartnerCommissionRule.description:
One commission or incentive rule under an agreement: the model, the product, venue, event, market and channel it applies to, the percent, amount or tiers, and the dates. The agreement's own `commissionPercent` is the default these rules refine (decided 29 September, data model DM4)

PartnerCreditProfile.description:
The credit controls around an agreement's approved limit: thresholds, a temporary limit and its end, the owner, the risk class and the credit status. The approved limit itself stays `PartnerAgreement.creditLimit`; this row is how it is watched (decided 29 September, data model DM4)

**Written by** setPartnerCreditProfile; enabling credit, a temporary limit and loosened thresholds go through approvals.request, a manual hold applies at once (decided 29 September, writers pass; DM4).

agreementId.description: The agreement (control.partner_agreement) this row belongs to.

temporaryCreditLimit.description: Temporary credit limit; empty when none.

warningThresholdPercent.description: Warning at this utilisation percent (decided 29 September, readiness close-out).

highRiskThresholdPercent.description: High risk at this utilisation percent (decided 29 September, readiness close-out).

blockThresholdPercent.description: Block at this utilisation percent (decided 29 September, readiness close-out).

creditStatus.description: Credit status. withinLimit, warning and highRisk are recomputed from utilisation against the thresholds; onHold and blocked are set by finance and stay until lifted.

approvalRequestId.description: The approvals.request raised when credit was enabled, a temporary limit set or a threshold loosened; those changes are not in force until it is approved (decided 29 September, writers pass; DM4)

scopePath.description: The partition key (ADR-0005), written at `tenant` scope.
